verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee is a web-scraping API/SaaS product, not an agent or orchestration platform that would itself consume other MCP servers' tools; evidence only shows it exposes its own MCP server (mcp.scrapingbee.com), i.e., it is the tool provider, not a tool consumer. Plugging external MCP servers into ScrapingBee to gain their tools is a category error for this kind of product.
